Pier uses a non-overlapping leading-dot translation of the same host policy and passes proxy certificates to Git and pip; separate verifiers retain native isolation.
Certificate and regex-log tasks were exposed in earlier smoke runs; build-cython-ext had a network-blocked attempt. These records and their costs are retained outside this final uniform cohort.
All 30 formal tasks start fresh under this final launch bundle; the first valid attempt under this configuration is canonical.

The combined $100 budget includes earlier smoke and infrastructure work. Vendor aggregate billing is checked before each task; interrupted-call costs can be reconciled without inventing individual token counts.
